entities.name: NAS security parameters to E-UTRA
entities.description: Information element that provides parameters enabling the UE to create a mapped EPS security context and use it after inter-system handover to S1 mode. It is a Type 3 IE with 7 octets length.

entities.name: NonceMME value
entities.description: Nonce value field coded as in the Nonce information element. Occupies octets 2-5.

entities.name: Type of integrity protection algorithm
entities.description: Field indicating the integrity protection algorithm type, coded as in NAS security algorithms IE. Occupies bits 1-3 of octet 6.

entities.name: Type of ciphering algorithm
entities.description: Field indicating the ciphering algorithm type, coded as in NAS security algorithms IE. Occupies bits 5-7 of octet 6.

entities.name: NAS key set identifier
entities.description: NAS key set identifier field coded as in NAS key set identifier IE. Occupies bits 1-3 of octet 7.

entities.name: Type of security context flag (TSC)
entities.description: Type of security context flag field coded as in NAS key set identifier IE. Occupies bit 4 of octet 7.

entities.name: Mapped EPS security context creation
entities.description: System behavior where UE creates a mapped EPS security context using parameters from NAS security parameters to E-UTRA IE.

entities.name: Inter-system handover to S1 mode
entities.description: Condition triggering the use of mapped EPS security context created from NAS security parameters to E-UTRA IE.
